::: {.lib-hero}
LIB002 is a self-paced learning resource developed by SMU Libraries for postgraduate researchers and research staff. It introduces essential research practices and points you towards useful tools, resources and specialist support.
:::

::: {#how-to-use .content-band .content-band--soft}
## How to use LIB002

Begin with a current question, or work through all five modules over time. Each one stands on its own and there is no required order.

LIB002 is not a comprehensive research methods course. Think of it as a front door: use it to orient yourself, strengthen a particular skill, or find the next source of help.
:::

::: {.support-panel}
::: {.support-panel__content}
## Research is easier with the right support

LIB002 is a starting point. SMU Libraries can help you move from general guidance to support for your own research needs.
